title: Doubling Reply Rates for an HR Tech SaaS Platform
challenge: An HR technology company offered an employee management solution but struggled to differentiate itself in a crowded market. Its LinkedIn outreach used generic product messaging and generated few meaningful responses.
solution: Myntmore redesigned the company's ICP strategy, segmenting HR leaders by organisation size and operational challenges. We introduced personalised outreach around employee engagement, administrative workload and HR efficiency, supported by educational content.
